reason: We already pay for Claude and Codex cloud agents and their built-in scheduling covers what we need. Another pre-alpha tool from one developer is not something I add to the stack this quarter.
objection: Our clients may not allow AI agents on their code, and I can't sell them on a one-person pre-alpha tool running overnight on our machines.
would_change_my_mind: A client contract that explicitly allows agents only on our own hardware, plus proof that the morning PRs actually pass review more often than what our vendor agents produce.
